svg.title: Two enlarged cross-sections of a flat pale oxide over a thin hatched film and a thin purple pad, which stands on a larger tungsten plug. Before the step a violet resist with a narrow window lies on the oxide. After it the resist is gone and under the window a small hole with sloping walls, narrower at the bottom, goes down through the oxide and the hatched film to the pad.
svg.desc: Two enlarged cross-sections of a flat pale oxide over a thin hatched film and a thin purple pad, which stands on a larger tungsten plug. Before the step a violet resist with a narrow window lies on the oxide. After it the resist is gone and under the window a small hole with sloping walls, narrower at the bottom, goes down through the oxide and the hatched film to the pad.
svg.text: A fluorocarbon plasma etches the holes through the oxide and
the nitride cap to the local interconnect; the resist is stripped.
After: a tapered hole down to the local interconnect
Close-up of the right-hand metal contact, enlarged
about 2.7×; the lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
